description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Delete an agent knowledge source

Removes one knowledge source from a voice agent: the entry is deleted and the agent no longer draws on the document. The indexed document is deleted from the voice engine as well, unless another entry or another agent still uses it. The entry must belong to this agent, otherwise the request is rejected with 404. A failure in the voice engine is logged and does not stop the local deletion. This endpoint takes no request body.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

knowledgeId.description: Identifier of the knowledge entry to remove.

name: delete_agent_knowledge
title: Delete an agent knowledge source
